qt: to the Commission Catherine Griset (PfE) Subject:
Blocking the online sale of items stolen during the riots of 17 October 2026 in France

After France was rocked by riots on 17 October 2026, the French Government summoned the main online (re)sale platforms – such as Vinted, Amazon, Cdiscount, eBay and Leboncoin – for talks. The platforms were urged to remove listings for stolen goods and to cooperate actively with the investigative services to identify any looters who might seek to offload their spoils online. 1.

Given the cross-border nature of these platforms, can the Commission say whether the specialist European agencies – Europol and Eurojust, in particular – are working to support the French authorities in their fight against the looters?
Is it possible to freeze the bank accounts and digital wallets (PayPal, Vinted balance, etc.) of these individuals and their accomplices from abroad?
